title: A hook-excess inequality for the support of Kronecker products of symmetric group characters
summary: We prove that if the Kronecker coefficient g(λ, μ, ν) of three partitions of n is positive, then the number of cells of ν outside its first two rows and first two columns is at most the sum of the numbers of cells of λ and of μ outside their first hooks. For two hooks this is the classical theorem of Remmel and Rosas, which our induction uses as its base case; we also give a computer-assisted proof of that base case (an exact rational certificate checked by an independent program) and a Lean 4 formalisation for the Specht modules of every symmetric group, whose only non-standard ingredient…
